console hint: Ctrl+Enter runs · sandboxed Web Worker (no DOM/Cordova)
settings-info-ssh-new: Add servers in the file browser (+ menu → SFTP). They show up here for one-tap SSH terminals.
settings-info-ssh-empty: Add an SFTP connection first — credentials stay protected in the native SFTP profile.
settings-info-ssh-list: Saved SFTP servers. Open an SSH terminal with one tap.
settings-info-main-ssh: Saved SSH sessions: open a remote terminal with one tap.
settings-info-font-install: Download a font (.ttf/.otf/.woff2) from a link and install it in the app.
settings-info-font-editor: Choose the code editor font (includes your installed fonts).
settings-info-font-app: Choose the app interface font (empty = system default).
settings-info-font-installed: Custom fonts installed in this device.
settings-info-main-fonts: Install fonts from a URL and set the editor and app fonts.
terminal onboarding reinstalled: Environment removed — it will be reinstalled on next open
